name: India's Got Talent
description: This talent show features a huge variety of talent ranging from the mundane to the bizarre from heart-stopping feats to the seemingly impossible giving Indians a platform to showcase their talents like no other.

videos.title: Season six begins
videos.overview: 'India's got talent' proves to be the best platform in giving talent a boost as it kick starts its sixth season. The first episode has aerial acts and aqua acts.

videos.title: WOAH! Karan got a lap dance!
videos.overview: Akshay Kumar continues with his underwater act. Karan Johar gets a lap dance, mentalist's tricks, Chinese opera act and street rap is what this episode has in store.

videos.title: Awesomeness inside Circus
videos.overview: The stage is set in a circus and the three judges witness stunts and performances which seem to be dangerous, beautiful and heart stopping.

videos.title: Have you ever heard of 'Flute-Boxing'?
videos.overview: Opening with an international act and ending with a first time ever flute-boxing on India's got talent, this episode promises wonderful entertainment.

videos.title: Karan Johar's #GharWapsi on India's Got Talent
videos.overview: Karan Johar seems to be missing, but the talent doesn't stop from flowing on India's got talent's stage. As he joins back, he brings along a wave of fresh talent.

videos.title: Witness a beautiful Bacchon ki Qawwali
videos.overview: Zombie dance, Qawwali by children and a dance on the theme of Krishna and many other performances make this episode a must watch.

videos.title: Stage is set for 'Bombay Velvet'
videos.overview: Amongst the high level performances of woo doo doll and gymnastics, Karan Johar along with Ranbir Kapoor and Anushka Sharma promote their film 'Bombay Velvet'.

videos.title: Anushka Sharma volunteers for a powerpacked act
videos.overview: Judges and guests volunteer in an act. Anushka Sharma stands for an animal that was a part of the act. A lot of performances surprise both the judges and the guests.

videos.title: Celebrities got weird talent
videos.overview: Famous television celebrities showcase their hidden talent which ranges from singing to magic. The judges are in for a surprise in this celebrity episode.

videos.title: Goosebumps Guaranteed!
videos.overview: There are some honest performances which turn out to be funny and then there are performances which give us goose bumps.

videos.title: Have a look at Malaika's doppelganger
videos.overview: The episode kick starts with a dance performance by Malaika's doppelganger, an escape artist and a mime act which scares Kiron Kher.

videos.title: Mime artist scares Kirron Kher
videos.overview: The episode kick starts with a dance performance by Malaika's doppelganger, an escape artist and a mime act which scares Kiron Kher.

videos.title: Karo ya maro in the 'Knock Out' round
videos.overview: The selected candidates have advanced to the 'Knock Out' round where they will be competing against each other to make their way to the semi-finals.

videos.title: Its 'Knock Out' round on India's Got Talent
videos.overview: The 'Knock Out' round is still on and the participants are giving their best to lure the judges. There is pure versatility on display as participants go head to head.

videos.title: Twisted Semi-final
videos.overview: 1st Semi-final with a twist! The two contestants who perform best will directly go for the pre-finale, one chosen by the judges and the other through an audience poll. The Judges vote for X1X juniors!

videos.title: Lokendra pal enters Pre-finale
videos.overview: Its the 2nd round of the semi-finals and eight contestants are performing. The judges pick Lokendra Pal to enter the pre-finale and the other selection depends upon the audience poll.

videos.title: The ABCD of talent!
videos.overview: It's the 3rd semi-final round! Remo D'Souza and Varun Dhawan have come for the promotion of ABCD 2. The judges change the rules a bit and select Warrior Dance Crew and Manik Paul for the pre-finale.

videos.title: Jogeshwari wins
videos.overview: The 4th semi-final round is here! With their extraordinary performances, participants win the hearts of the judges and Jogeshwari is selected using the judge's choice for the pre-finale.

videos.title: First Three finalists of IGT 6!
videos.overview: Nine pre-finalists are chosen to compete with the six challengers from IGT 5. Yogeshwari Mistry, Prahlad Acharya and X1X group are the first three finalists of IGT 6!

videos.title: Who are the FINAL 6 OF IGT 6?
videos.overview: The pre-finale round 2 is here. Harmanpreet & Parry G, Manik Paul and Beat Breakers are announced as the next three finalists of IGT 6. The final six contestants will face the toughest challenge.

videos.title: Grand finale Season 6
videos.overview: And the Grand Finale is finally here! Anupam Kher is tonight's guest on the show. The one who wins IGT Season 6 is none other than Manik Paul!

videos.title: Start with a bang
videos.overview: The brand new season of India's Got Talent brings more marvelous performers who leave the judges speechless. Later, Bharthi romances with the shy Tiger Shroff, who arrives with Shraddha Kapoor to promote their film Baaghi.

videos.title: Wheeling one's way to fame and glory
videos.overview: Despite all adversities, Malkit comes to the show and allures everyone with his amazing German wheel performance. The Judges are also amazed by the other performances including an unique Qawwali by Tina and Rishab's extraordinary dance form.

videos.title: Entertainment Galore!
videos.overview: Enthralled by a spectacular performance by the Acro Kings. Raj's animated popping skills, the mentalist Abhishek's tricks and little Parth's fiery performance flabbergast the judges. Fun acts like the unique ostrich dance is guaranteed to keep you entertained.

videos.title: Enthralling Show of Talent
videos.overview: A dinosaur appears on set and terrifies the unsuspecting judges. Aditya, a tiny contortionist mesmerizes the judges with his rubber like spine. Special guest, Emraan Hashmi, and the judges are spellbound by Akash and Adharv's contemporary dance performance.

videos.title: Youngest contestant of India's Got Talent
videos.overview: The beautiful Aishwarya Rai Bachchan and Randeep Hooda make an appearance to promote their upcoming movie 'Sarabjit'. Among multiple performances, the youngest contestant in the show, steals the judges' hearts with her spectacular archery performance.

videos.title: The perfect storm of Talent
videos.overview: India's Got Talent shoots on ice, where the contestants display their spectacular skating and dancing skills. Anna, an Ukrainian performer wows the judges with her rather unique talent. The other talents follow suit, setting the stage on fire.

videos.title: Mesmerizing talents unleashed
videos.overview: The judges are charmed by some serene contemporary dancing while their minds explode when a magician baffles them with his spectacular card tricks. Later, a mother and daughter's soulful song strikes an emotional chord with all the judges.

videos.title: Extraordinary display of talent
videos.overview: Two kids, Indrajit and Ritik perform a death defying hanging Malkhamb and the judges are swept away with their skills and incredible composure. Little Pari's energetic dance performance and Sandra's sensuous voice take the episode to a whole new level.

videos.title: Hunarpur ke Hunarbaaz
videos.overview: The judges make a bhangra style entrance in the new set at Hunarpur where they are greeted by the marks women of Baghpat. Then, they meet the Jugaad men of Rawal Academy and a couple of other groups. However, which groups qualify remains to be seen.

videos.title: Ticket to Semi-Finals
videos.overview: The contestants have a new challenge. If they can impress the judges enough with their performance, they will earn a direct seat into the semi-finals. The stage is set. The bar is high. Who will rise to the challenge?

videos.title: Bollywood sets the show rolling
videos.overview: Watch India shine as Sheetal Mahajan, a professional skydiver hoist the India's Got Talent flag, thousands of feet above the ground. Later, Akshay Kumar, Jacqueline Fernandez, Riteish Deshmukh and Abhishek Bachchan promote their movie Housefull 3.

videos.title: Parineeti's sparkling presence
videos.overview: With Parineeti Chopra on the show and Karan Johar dressed in a leather jacket, there's no shortage of style and glamour. Later, flames will threaten the acrobatic artists as they perform miraculous feats and push themselves to the limits.

videos.title: Sulaiman captures everyone's hearts
videos.overview: The judges are treated to a series of breathtaking performances of song and dance. Later, young Sulaiman outdoes everyone with his masterful skill at playing the flute.

videos.title: A glorious journey
videos.overview: Be amazed by performances that vary from dancing to 'kawali' to a choir from Nagaland. Be a part of the journey that began with the auditions and is still going strong.

videos.title: Survival of the most talented
videos.overview: Amazing talent, breath-taking performances and tears - that is what one gets in this special face-off episode. From 'Qawwali' to 'Rock and Roll' and an inspiring shadow act, who will survive and march forward? Also watch Kirron and Malaika groove to the beats of a band on stage.

videos.title: Ticket to the semis with the 'Golden Freeze'
videos.overview: With the 'Golden Freeze' introduced, the contestants now have a chance to seal their place in the semi-finals. With scintillating dances, sultry singing, daredevil acts, and stand up comedy, who will linger in the spotlight?

videos.title: Spellbinding performances to reach the finals
videos.overview: It's time to select the last 3 finalists. One team will be chosen by the judges and qualify for the finals directly. The other 2 teams will be selected by the viewers' votes. With brilliant acts from all the teams, which one will the judges select?

videos.title: Maa tujhe salaam!
videos.overview: A soulful song sung by Rajeev, helps lift up the spirit of the audience. Later, a patriotic themed dance by the 'Rock On Crew' group, leads to a standing ovation from the judges and the crowd. With great performances lined up, this stage is on fire!

videos.title: A blind romance
videos.overview: Karan entertains us with his special karaoke performance. Exceptionally talented performers present a blindfold dance which leaves everyone in awe. Later, the finalists are announced, although, the judges have a surprise up their sleeve.

videos.title: The Sultan leaves his mark
videos.overview: Salman Khan and Anushka Sharma grace the stage and marvel at the fantastic skills that the finalists have to offer. Who will be top in a nail-biting contest? From daring 'Mallakhamba' moves to dazzling instrumentalists, this episode has it all.

videos.title: IGT - Season 7 Grand Finale
videos.overview: Graced by Anil Kapoor's presence, the grand finale sees the top five contestants perform mind boggling acts leaving the judges and guests, John Abraham, Varun Dhawan and Jacqueline Fernandez, in awe. Whose talent will claim the season 7 grand title?

videos.title: A grand opening!
videos.overview: India's Got Talent is back with their latest season and this time it promises to be bigger and better. Things kick off on the right note as Arjun Kapoor and Parineeti Chopra join the glamorous panel of judges in the very first episode.

videos.title: Swag of Rajasthan!
videos.overview: The Desi band Swagsthan create an electrifying atmosphere with their sensational fusion of Rajasthani folk music with rock and rap. The other performances include a daredevil stunt by Gunjan and an acrobatic spectacle by Rahul-Mukesh.

videos.title: Almaz goes airborne!
videos.overview: The performances are getting bigger and better as the judges are rendered speechless by young aerial artist, Almaz Khan. Catch all the fun from this segment including a musical performance by Swaranjali Music Academy.

videos.title: Malaika's Live 100 experience
videos.overview: This week's unlimited dose of fun and entertainment starts with an astounding act of Malkhamb. But things become really exciting when the musical group, Live 100 Experience performs which even inspire Malaika Arora to join them.

videos.title: Mr. Indian Hacker's experimental act
videos.overview: The judges are in for a surprising night as Mr. Indian Hacker comes up with a highly volatile performance. Things get really interesting as Malaika Arora and Rithvik Dhanjani take part in his fun science experiment.

videos.title: A daring trapeze act!
videos.overview: The judges are in for a nail-biting session as Pramod Patel and Jugal Nachnani perform a dangerous trapeze act. What's so daring? They deliver the amazing aerial stunts above a bed filled with spikes!

videos.title: Jamuna circus stuns the judges
videos.overview: As the beautiful and talented girls of Jamuna circus take the stage, the judges and audience watch in awe. All the three judges get impressed by their difficult formations and give them a big yes!

videos.title: Epic! A car seesaw!
videos.overview: Two stuntmen, Rahees and Zeshan, pull off the most dangerous stunt of the season, a car seesaw. But the entertainment doesn't end there as Bidhisha Mohantha impresses the judges with her soulful singing.

videos.title: Off goes the golden buzzer!
videos.overview: A soft spoken Rammy Singh blows away the judges with his unmatched talent in dancing. When a talent like that is presented in its full glory, the golden buzzer is meant to go off, giving Rammy a golden chance! Catch all the powerhouse performances in this latest episode of India's Got Talent.

videos.title: Golden Buzzer for a golden heart
videos.overview: Circus is a fading art form but struggling and humble circus performer R G Rathore gets to the stage with one intention - Help the Nation recognise the value of this art. His magnificent stunts on the tightrope leave the judges with no choice but to give him the ultimate prize - The Golden Buzzer!

videos.title: When tradition meets Jazz
videos.overview: Jazz may have its roots in a different land, but Anjali who headlines the band Punch has made it her own. Anjali isn't the traditional jazz musician, but she brings something much more unique which leaves everyone mesmerized.

videos.title: Mentalist bewitches Malaika
videos.overview: Mentalism is an art form which only a few manage to master. One such mentalist arrives on the grand stage of India's Got Talent and captivates everyone as he bewitches judge Malaika Arora.

videos.title: Straight to the Semis!
videos.overview: Crazy Hoppers, the dance group from Agra blow everyone's mind as they set the bar with their awe-inspiring performace. So brilliant is their performance that the judges give them a ticket straight to the semi-finals.

videos.title: Fight for a spot in the semi-finale
videos.overview: With an impressive gamut of talent from all the nooks and corners of India, the judges have a hard time selecting the artists for the semi-finale! From powerful singles to majestic groups, everyone gets a chance to prove their worth and go through the tough ordeal of selection and rejection. Watch the pinnacle of artistry to know who climbs the ladder of success in the latest episode of India's Got Talent.

videos.title: Sara-Sushant steal the show
videos.overview: The competition for the three precious spotlights is on as the contestants deliver their best to seal their spots at the semi-finals. But it's the glamorous duo of Sushant Singh Rajput and Sara Ali Khan that grabs the real spotlight as the guest judges.

videos.title: Riteish-Saiyami light up the semis
videos.overview: It's not just any semi-finals, it's a star-studded semi-final! With the lead actors of the upcoming flick Mauli, Riteish Deshmukh and Saiyami Kher making a fabulous entry, the crowd goes wild and the contestants get ready for their decisive performances. From enjoying to the fullest to getting inspired from the contestants, Riteish and Saiyami raise the level of fun and entertainment!

videos.title: Katrina-Anushka at the Semi-Finale!
videos.overview: From SST Warning Crew bringing Disneyland to the stage, to Altmas wowing the judges with her mesmerising performance, the road to finale is one that will put you at the edge of your seat! Watch as Katrina Kaif and Anushka Sharma join the semi-final stage and shake a leg in this episode.

videos.title: Proneeta Vs Kirron: The Twerk debate
videos.overview: The Semi finale is on at full throttle as the contestants deliver the performances of their lives in hopes of sealing a spot at the finale. But this contest is not without a bit of tension, exemplified by judge Kirron Kher's conflict with Proneeta Swargyari regarding her twerking. Will the judge's objection cost Proneeta a spot in the finals?

videos.title: Last Semi with Vicky and Yami!
videos.overview: It's the last semi-finale of the season and Vicky Kaushal and Yami Gautam, lead actors of the upcoming flick Uri, are here to cheer the contestants one last time before they give it their all to get one step closer to making history. Watch this glorious episode and catch Vicky and Yami go awestruck with the talent unleashed royally on stage.

videos.title: A Sufi tribute to married man Ranveer
videos.overview: The hunt for the top 5 has begun with the pre finale contest. Hold on to your seats because some extra special guests have joined the judges' panel for this extra special contest. They are none other than the cast of Simmba! But it is the Sufi Nizami Brothers who dazzle the evening by paying a musical tribute to the newly married man Ranveer Singh.

videos.title: Grand finale, grand twist: A tie!
videos.overview: After weeks of many jaw dropping performances, the big moment is finally here - The Grand finale! Brace yourself, for there is a grand twist in store for the unsuspecting contestants because for the first time in the show's history, the result is a tie! Now which fortunate performer will taste glory in the inevitable tie breaker and claim the precious trophy?

videos.title: Hindustan Ka Hunar
videos.overview: India's Got Talent brings to the stage a combination of unique talent from across the country supported by India's biggest superstars, Kirron Kher, Manoj Muntashir, Badshah and Shilpa Shetty.

videos.title: India's Best Talent
videos.overview: Watch Crazy Hopper's tribute to Lord Ganesh, Warrior Squad's acrobatic performance, Divyansh and Manuraj's musical collab, B.S Reddy's magical act and many more terrific acts on India's biggest show.

videos.title: Entertainment Todega Sabhi Salaakhein
videos.overview: Be a part of an entertaining night with acts from all over the country. From body to body balancing acts, fire shows, acrobatics, folk music and many more. India's biggest talent show is back with another banger.

videos.title: Chamkega Qismat Ka Taara
videos.overview: Witness a night filled with elegant pole dancing, soulful qawwali singing, a record-breaking act, and much more. This edition of India's biggest talent show is going to be one for the ages.

videos.title: Zimmedaari Ki Dastak
videos.overview: From mallakhamba to singing to magic to funny acts, India's Got Talent has everything for the audiences to watch and get thrilled.

videos.title: Beparvah Hunar
videos.overview: An exhilarating jump rope performance, a melodic father-daughter duo, a dangerous callisthenics presentation, and much more. The biggest stage for talent has something for everyone.

videos.title: Aasmaan Chuega India
videos.overview: IROCK Dance Crew, Pop Boys and Bengal Tigers bring their jaw-dropping choreography. Gaurav Singh's daredevil act, Rajeev Chamba's mesmerising voice and much more. Catch the best talent that India has to offer that will leave you on the edge of your seats.

videos.title: Mauke Par Chauka
videos.overview: An innovative Hula Hoop performance, an astonishing martial art presentation, a spooky magical act, and much more. The IGT stage is teeming with boundless talent.

videos.overview: It's time for India's Got Talent's Grand Premiere, where India celebrates the top 14 acts from all over the country.

videos.title: Talent Ka Grand Premiere
videos.overview: Grand Premiere for the greatest talent show in India continues, as the top fourteen contestants showcase their unbridled skill in front of the entire nation.

videos.title: Dharmendra Ji Special - Part 1
videos.overview: Witness the never seen before talent on India's Got Talent with the evergreen He-man of Bollywood, Dharmendra.

videos.title: Dharmendra Ji Special - Part 2
videos.overview: The talent marathon continues on India's Got Talent with none other than Dharmendra.

videos.overview: Bollywood's Bhidu, Jackie Shroff, graces his presence on India's Got Talent and supports the contestants with his words.

videos.overview: The entertainment continues with Jackie Shroff, as the contestants are eager to showcase their unique talent and make it to the Top 12.

videos.title: Rohit Shetty Special
videos.overview: Bollywood's biggest action director, Rohit Shetty, makes a stellar entry to support the contestants this evening on India's Got Talent.

videos.title: The Fame Game Special
videos.overview: The level of entertainment is about to shoot up, as the star cast of 'The Fame Game', the sensational Madhuri Dixit, Sanjay Kapoor, and Manav Kaul arrive on India's Got Talent.

videos.title: Holi Special
videos.overview: Bollywood's famous jodi, Govinda and Karisma Kapoor join the judges to celebrate Holi with the IGT contestants.

videos.title: Holi Special With Govinda And Karisma
videos.overview: The super hit Jodi of Govinda and Karisma Kapoor arrives on the IGT stage as the contestants gear up for Holi and the next round of eliminations.

videos.title: Rishtey Special
videos.overview: India's Got Talent mein aaj, rishton ki dor hogi aur bhi mazboot. Jab is manch par rishton ka jashn manaane ayengi Kirron ji ki purani sathi Malaika Arora, Badshah ki tabahi partner Tamannaah Bhatia, aur judge Kirron Kher ke bete Sikandar Kher.

videos.title: Bappi Da Special
videos.overview: India's Got Talent mein aaj Bappi Da ke dhuno par jhoomega India, jab hunar karega Bappi Da ke sunhere sangeet ko celebrate.

videos.title: Attack Challenge
videos.overview: John Abraham, Rakul Preet Singh and Jacqueline Fernandez make a stellar entry to the show and support the contestants in their race to the finale.

videos.title: India Special
videos.overview: Get ready for a night to remember, as the contestants gear up to showcase their talents and pay a tribute to their motherland.

videos.title: Dasvi's Cast On India's Got Talent
videos.overview: Witness the cast of the upcoming film Dasvi on India's Got Talent as the contestants inch closer to the finale.

videos.title: Jersey's Cast On India's Got Talent
videos.overview: Shahid Kapoor and Mrunal Thakur come as guests to promote their upcoming film Jersey and show support for the contestants in the race to the finale.

videos.title: Judges Special
videos.overview: Witness the unlimited talent of the contestants in today's 'Judges Special' where the top 8 contestants pay a tribute to the judges.

videos.title: IGT Semi Finals
videos.overview: The contestants are ready to bring out their best for the semi-finals. Who will advance further and who will bid farewell to the IGT stage?

videos.title: Pre Finale
videos.overview: Talent and skills are on full display as the contestants prepare for the IGT grand finale.

videos.title: Grand Finale
videos.overview: India's Got Talent Season 9 Grand Finale is finally here. The stage is set, and the contestants are ready. Some of the biggest names from the Hindi Film Industry are also here to cheer them on. But who will walk away with the prestigious IGT trophy?

videos.title: Vijayi Vishwa Hunar
videos.overview: India's Got Talent is back with phenomenal acts by the participants that will salute and honour the talent of India along with Badshah, Kirron Kher and Shilpa Shetty.

videos.title: Unleashing India's Hidden Gems
videos.overview: India's biggest talent showcase is here to bring the hidden gems of the country to the limelight. Which act will blow the judges away with their spectacular skills?

videos.title: Hunar Ki Talaash
videos.overview: India's opera singer, a group of dancers wearing heels, young kids doing Mallakhamba and many such acts in India's Got Talent. Who will get the golden buzzer?

videos.title: Break The Record
videos.overview: Today, India will not only break but also set new world records with the Guinness World Record on the stage of India’s Got Talent. Who will break records and win the judges’ hearts?

videos.title: Hauslo Ki Chhalang
videos.overview: Botlab Dynamics' drone show, Powai Undefeated Crew's dance performance, Anuska Chatterjee's daring act, and many more acts give the judges goosebumps. Who will get the golden buzzer?

videos.title: Auditions Ka Akhri Daur
videos.overview: The legendary Anupam Kher joins the judges in their pursuit of discovering the exceptional talent of India during the final round of auditions. Which contestant's performance will leave the biggest impression on the judges?

videos.title: Talent Ka World Premiere
videos.overview: Witness the daring and entertaining acts of the top 14 contestants of India's Got Talent in today's Grand Premiere episode.

videos.title: Hunar Ka Naya Rang
videos.overview: Talent Ka World Premiere' continues as Superstar Javed Ali joins the judges to witness some mind-blowing acts and performances.

videos.overview: Witness never seen before acts which include power-packed dance performances, magical musical performances, horror acts and much more along with Ayushmann Khurrana and Ananya Panday

videos.title: Desh Ki Mitti Se Jude Hunarbaaz
videos.overview: Musical sensation, Gurdas Maan, arrives on the stage of India's Got Talent while all the top 14 contestants prepare to showcase their exceptional talents and awe the audience with their performances.

videos.title: Hunar Ka Jalwa
videos.overview: The talents put their best foot forward in acrobatics, dancing, singing and much more in the presence of rapper, lyricist and actor Raftaar. Who will reach the finale?

videos.title: Janmashtami Special
videos.overview: IGT celebrates Krishna Janmashtami with the renowned 'Bhajan Samraat' Anup Jalota, as the contestants get ready to present the rich culture of India with their talent.

videos.title: Hunar Ka Alag Andaaz
videos.overview: Ace choreographer and director Farah Khan graces her presence on the stage of India's Got Talent to support the unique talent of the contestants.

videos.title: Indian Railway Special
videos.overview: The contestants give a tribute to The Indian Railways as Farah Khan continues to support the unique talent displayed at India's Got Talent.

videos.title: Ganesh Chaturthi Special
videos.overview: India's Got Talent celebrates Ganesh Chaturthi with the cast of 'The Great Indian Family', Vicky Kaushal and Manushi Chhillar. Who will make their way to the finale?

videos.title: Judge's Challenge
videos.overview: Social media sensation Kusha Kapila arrives on the show to motivate the contestants during the Judge's Challenge.

videos.title: Rishton Ka Reunion
videos.overview: Rahul Roy, Chunky Panday, Deepak Tijori and Ayesha Jhulka grace their presence on India's Got Talent and support the contestants in their quest to the finale.

videos.title: Bemisaal Reunion
videos.overview: Superstar Rahul Roy, Deepak Tijori and Ayesha Jhulka arrive on the stage of India's Got Talent to make the reunion even more special.

videos.title: Party Special - Part 1
videos.overview: Musical sensation Neha Kakkar joins the party on the IGT stage and celebrates the talent of all the contestants.

videos.title: Party Special - Part 2
videos.overview: Esteemed Indian Idol judges Kumar Sanu and Vishal Dadlani join the party as the celebration of talent continues on IGT.

videos.overview: The contestants put their best foot forward and display immense talent to get the golden buzzer from the judges in order to reach the top 8 and the contestants are accompanied by the star cast of the upcoming movie, 'Thank You for Coming', Bhumi Pednekar, Kusha Kapila, Shehnaaz Gill, Shibani Bedi and Dolly Singh.

videos.title: Golden Buzzer Special - Part 2
videos.overview: The contestants put their best foot forward and display immense talent to get the golden buzzer from the judges in order to reach the top 8. The contestants are accompanied by the cast of the upcoming movie, 'Yaariyan 2', Divya Khosla Kumar, Pearl V Puri and Meezaan Jafri.

videos.title: Mass Mania Special
videos.overview: Get ready for yet another mind-blowing episode of India's Got Talent, featuring Ravi Teja, Nupur Sanon, and Gayatri Bhardwaj as they promote their latest film, 'Tiger Nageswara Rao'

videos.title: Navaratri Special
videos.overview: On the pious occasion of Navaratri, Yogrishi Swami Ramdev joins the judges of India's Got Talent to witness the amazing talent India has to offer.

videos.title: Talent Aur Entertainment Ka Dum
videos.overview: Legendary writer and director, Vidhu Vinod Chopra, joins the IGT judges to witness the unbelievable talent displayed by all the contestants.

videos.title: Entertainment Ki Udaan
videos.overview: The entertainment quotient goes a notch higher as the contestants display a wide array of talent to reach the top 7. Which contestants will make it to the finale?

videos.title: India's Got Talent Ka Semi-Finals
videos.overview: India's Got Talent gears up for the semi-finals as the contestants fight it out for the top 6. Who will make it to the finale?

videos.title: Welcome Jhalak Dikhhla Ja
videos.overview: The top 6 finalists deliver captivating performances, while the hosts of the show, Jhalak Dikhhla Ja, Rithvik Dhanjani and Gauahar Khan, grace the event alongside contestants Tanishaa S Mukerji, Adrija Sinha, Rajiv Thakur and Sangeeta Phogat.

videos.title: Hunar Ka Vishwa Cup - Grand Finale - Part 1
videos.overview: Over several weeks, the contestants have put their best foot forward and shown talent that is beyond commendable as they gear up for the Grand Finale with director and producer Karan Johar. Who will take home the title?

videos.title: Hunar Ka Vishwa Cup - Grand Finale - Part 2
videos.overview: The contestants persist in their pursuit of the title, showcasing their exceptional talents and offering heartfelt tribute to the remarkably accomplished Karan Johar.

videos.title: Hindustan Ka Hunar
videos.overview: India's Got Talent returns with its 11th season, featuring judges Navjot Singh Sidhu, Shaan, and Malaika Arora, all geared up to witness the country's finest performers. Will the contestants manage to surprise the judges this time?

videos.title: India's Incredible Talent
videos.overview: Navjot Singh Sidhu, Shaan, and Malaika Arora witness the incredible acts of participants who vie to move into the next round of India's Got Talent Season 11.

videos.title: Spine-Chilling Acts
videos.overview: From Nepal Tigers' electrifying dance act to a young girl's yoga performance with her grandmother and a group of callisthenics athletes, the stage of India's Got Talent is set. Who will win the golden buzzer?

videos.title: Heartwarming Performances
videos.overview: Dhanraj Saha from Guwahati, Aflatunes from Mumbai, Ramesh Bishnoi from Jodhpur, Anwar's Lil Flames from Siliguri, Hawaldar Simanchal Barik, Mohit Chopra Live Band from Delhi, and Vivek Soni from Pune, perform before the judges. Who will make it to the next round of this season of India's Got Talent?

videos.title: Where Talent Meets Magic
videos.overview: Acrobatic yoga, 30 tabla players performing together for the first time, a strongman act, and many more incredible talents light up the stage of India's Got Talent. Who will shine tonight?

videos.title: Exceptional Skills, Remarkable Talent
videos.overview: Akshay Sarode from Pune, Belgaum Beauties from Belagavi, Aashid Khan from Jodhpur, The Royal Symphony and Choir from Chhattisgarh, RD Warriors from Mumbai, Coffee and Zayie from Kohima, A Lycans from Greater Noida and Tulsi Molparia from Delhi, perform before the judges. Who will qualify for the next round?

videos.title: Aar Ya Paar - Part 1
videos.overview: The contestants deliver spectacular and daring performances, knowing this is their final chance to secure a place in the semi-finals. With fifteen remarkable talents and only two spots left, who will rise above the rest?

videos.title: Aar Ya Paar - Part 2
videos.overview: Salim Merchant joins the judges as the next batch of talented contestants vie to make their place in the semi-finals. Who will get closer to the coveted title and secure a spot in the semi-finals?

videos.title: Josh Aur Junoon
videos.overview: The competition heats up as Anu Malik joins the panel to witness extraordinary talent like never before. Who will rise to the top this time?

videos.title: Himmat Aur Sahas
videos.overview: Anu Malik and the judges assess the performances put together by the exceptionally talented contestants. Which act will get applauded the most?

videos.title: Tadakte Bhadakte Acts
videos.overview: Team Yo Highness, Takshvi Vaghani, Ismail Khan Langa and group, along with many other spectacular performers, take over the spotlight tonight. Who will win the coveted golden buzzer?

videos.title: Kuch Anokha Karne Ka Junoon
videos.overview: Shehnaaz Gill arrives on the show and witnesses the spectacular performances of Chibi Unity from Japan, The Amazing Apsaras, Trio India, The Mondol Brothers and The Art from Kolkata, Rahul Sukun and Mukesh Kumar from Delhi. Who will move on to the next round?

videos.title: Record Breaking Performances
videos.overview: With powerful performances and exceptional talent on display, the stage is set for the contestants as singer Mika Singh arrives to grace the evening.

videos.title: Aaj Tutenge Records
videos.overview: The crew of the Hindi movie, 'Mastiii 4', arrives on the show and encourage the participants as they vie to break the Guinness World Records.

videos.title: Sunhere Sapno Ka Shikhar
videos.overview: The contestants gear up to showcase their best in the semifinal round, each hoping to earn the golden buzzer. With Sargun Mehta and Ravi Dubey gracing the show with their presence, who will rise to the moment?

videos.title: A Showcase Of Sheer Mastery
videos.overview: As the participants showcase their talent in a bid to move into the semi-finals, Sargun and Ravi sportingly partake in a dangerous act. Which act will be the most impressive?

videos.title: Chunky Panday Special
videos.overview: Chunky Panday joins the stage of India's Got Talent to witness incredible performers. Which contestant will stand out tonight?

videos.title: Kriti Sanon Special
videos.overview: As the participants deliver back-to-back spectacular performances, the ever-charming Kriti Sanon graces the show with her presence and witnesses the breathtaking display of talent.

videos.title: Sur Aur Talent Ka Mahasangam - Part 1
videos.overview: Vishal Dadlani and Shreya Ghoshal, the judges of Indian Idol, grace the stage with their vibrant presence. Which performer will steal the spotlight tonight?

videos.title: Sur Aur Talent Ka Mahasangam - Part 2
videos.overview: The final round of auditions takes place as the Indian Idol judges, Vishal Dadlani and Shreya Ghoshal, continue cheering the talented participants who vie for a spot in the next round. Who will make it through?

videos.title: Battle Of Existence - Part 1
videos.overview: The contestants are divided into batches for the final Aar Ya Paar challenge. As they give their best performances, who will rise to the occasion?

videos.title: Battle Of Existence - Part 2
videos.overview: The participants give their all as only one position into the semi-finals remains open. Who will grab the spot and make their place in the semi-finals?

videos.title: Semi-Final Ki Jung
videos.overview: The semi-final excitement grips the India's Got Talent stage as 36 contestants deliver dazzling performances, leaving the judges with a tough decision. Who will move ahead?

videos.title: Semi-Final Ki Jung - Part 2
videos.overview: The race for the final spot heats up as contestants give it their all, pushing limits and delivering their best performances to secure a place in the finale.

videos.title: Dhamakedar Saat Din
videos.overview: The excitement peaks in the semi finals as the judges face the tough decision of choosing the finalists. Who will shine in the final semi final round?

videos.title: Sangharsh Se Shoharat
videos.overview: The participants take part in the final battle as they vie for a spot in the semi-finals. Who will get the coveted Golden Buzzer?

videos.title: Ajab Gazab Finale
videos.overview: The judges are joined by Karisma Kapoor, Emran Hashmi, Sharad Kelkar, Zoya Afroz, and the judges of MasterChef India for the grand finale of this season of India's Got Talent.
